summary: Site footer component. The top row shows the 'common.selectLanguage' label and a language picker (globe SVG, current language name from LANG_DISPLAY_NAMES, a chevron arrow SVG and a scrollable dropdown of availableLangs, defaulting to AVAILABLE_LANGS) that toggles an 'active' class and closes via a click-outside ref hook; picking a language rewrites window.location.pathname by replacing '/<currentLang>' with '/<newLang>' and preserves the hash. The bottom container is a ref passed to Tracking.insertFooter so the Gryphline SDK renders the legal/footer links into it. Two inline SVG components (31x31 globe, 25x65 arrow) use an Object.assign polyfill to spread props.
